resources.string: Use DPAD Left and Right. Select Focus Probe to trigger the one seeded defect, or Recreate Activity to exercise same-package Activity recreation.
Focus Probe. Selecting this control deliberately loses focus.
Safe Control. Selecting this control keeps focus.
Recreate Activity. Selecting this control recreates this Activity in the same application package.
Ready. Focus Probe has initial focus.
Seeded defect triggered: no remote control has focus.
Safe Control selected. Focus remains available.
Activity recreation completed. Focus Probe has initial focus.
